notes.title: AereA - Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28124155/81a144ae23eeb95ea4494a829d3a98d228ed24fb.jpg
Hello, everyone!

We’re thrilled to share that AereA is back with a brand new update! Version 1.0.3 is now live on Steam, bringing a host of improvements, including balance adjustments for all heroes and enemies, plus fixes for bugs that disrupt the rhythm of your adventure.

We hope this update enhances your experience, and there’s plenty more on the way. Be sure to check out the full patch notes below for all the details!

Patch Notes: 

 Game balancing on all heroes and enemies.

HitPoints and Max HitPoints.
Damage given.
Exp obtained.
Cooldowns.
Potion effects.

 Fixed incorrect map display.
 Fixed collisions and boundaries.
 Fixed players getting locked in an area due to missing colliders.
 Fixed enemy clippings through walls/doors.
 Fixed blockers that don't allow player to progress.
 Fixed text, font and alignment in various scenarios.
 General bug fixes.


Thanks,
-SOEDESCO

notes.title: Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror launches March 28 on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28124155/11457eb25137af06de2ed55da314c8e9476677a6.jpg
Hello, Horror fans!

We’re thrilled to announce that Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror, the newest installment in the Dollhouse series, will officially launch on Steam on March 28, 2025! Prepare to join Eliza on a haunting journey through two nightmarish realities and uncover the twisted mystery of her broken mind. 

To celebrate, we’ve just unveiled a brand-new trailer, offering a glimpse into the immersive gameplay, unsettling challenges, and bone-chilling encounters that await in this psychological horror experience.

[previewyoutube=oIaeFDudFfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to add Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror to your wishlist today to stay updated on all the latest news and prepare yourself for the darkness ahead.

Wishlist NOW
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791660/Dollhouse_Behind_the_Broken_Mirror/

notes.title: AereA Artbook has been fully released
notes.content:
Today the third and final episode of the AereA artbook was released!

The artbook now contains a total of 93 pages full of art from the game including:

- The history of AereA
- The Characters of AereA
- The enemies of AereA
- The places of AereA
- Primordial Instruments
- The Weapons of AereA

Check it out if you haven't

You can get the artbook here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/624531/AereA__Artbook/

notes.title: AereA - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've received your feedback and we’ve implemented a couple of changes especially regarding the balancing of the game. The new patch is online now! You can find the list of changes made below:

- Balancing of enemies at the start of the game
- Balancing of skills of all classes
- Fixed text at character selection screen
- Fixed text at shop screen
- Fixed controller input for locking character movement using the left stick press

We’d like to thank you, the community, for your feedback which made this patch possible! We’ll keep our eyes and ears open for more.

Enjoy the game!
